testId: tests/webstore/CartCheckoutPage/CartCheckoutPageTest.spec.ts > SAN-003: Header search, Account and Logout work on the combined page

scenario.summary: As a created Sales Rep (Shop As) with an item, the Header search, Account and Logout still work from the combined page.
steps: Sign in on the storefront (config webstoreURL, /login) with the tester's own Admin account (config adminUsername / adminPassword, from env ADMIN_USERNAME / ADMIN_PASSWORD); the Web Admin Dashboard (/admin) opens
In Web Admin open Users, find the created Sales Rep by its user name (@user.userName) and choose Shop As; the storefront opens as that user with the impersonation header
Open the PDP /product/{@product.parentProductId}; the size grid is shown
Enter 1 for size @product.variant1Attr1 and click Add to Cart
Open the page from the Header Cart; run a Header search for @product.parentProductSku
Return to the page from the Header Cart and open Account from the Header
Return to the page and log out from the Header; check the tester is back in the own Admin session (impersonation header gone)
stateChanges: The Sales Rep user and its allotment are created for the test by their collections and deleted at teardown
Cart line added by Add to Cart
Logout ends the Shop As impersonation
assertions: The search opens the search results and they list @product.name
Logout ends the impersonation and returns the tester to the own Admin session (no impersonation header; not signed out)
evidence: Jira BMP-94 (story, FSD section 'Shopping Cart and Checkout', work/stories/BMP-94/input/) and manual cases SAN-003 (work/stories/BMP-94/input/BMP-94-testcases.md)

work/stories/BMP-94/analysis.md section 6: every role test signs in with the tester's own Admin account and reaches the created user through Shop As (user decision 2026-11-26); created users never sign in with a password, so 'signed in as <role>' in the cases is reached through Shop As

PRODUCT_CONFIGURABLE_SIZE_GRID (existing BNJM size-grid products, no price rule: BNJM variants are priced 0.00; user decision 2026-11-27) replaces the hardcoded /product/798 (BM05) and size Small of the cases; on qa product 798 (SKU BM05) is configured by attribute Size (ZnodePimConfigureProductAttribute -> PimAttributeId 129, AttributeCode Size), so variantAttributes = Size

Allotments: BIWW Allocations custom table, linked to the rep only by SalesRepEmail (analysis section 9); one ALLOTMENT_OF_USER_FOR_VARIANT need per variant the test enters, quantity = the highest quantity the test reaches for it
The case searches 'BM05' (the product SKU): the term is the product's SKU from the key

SAN-003 title mentions language; its steps do not, so no language check. SAN-003 'Logout should sign the user out' is read as ending the impersonated user's session: Decision 2026-11-27 (analysis section 11): Logout during Shop As ends the impersonation, not the Admin's session; after Logout the tester is back in the own Admin session

qa finding (2026-11-27): the Header Cart opens a cart drawer; its Checkout link opens the combined page. Pending a user decision whether this is a defect against SAN-011 (Header Cart opens the combined page directly); the test goes through the drawer
